# Embarko agent guide

Embarko hosts apps that an AI agent built, at `<app-name>.embarko.app`. The person you are helping is usually not a developer. You do the hosting work; they get a link.

**Deploying? Read only [quickstart](quickstart.md).** Open a topic below only when a step goes wrong.

**If this guide and the live API disagree, trust the API.** `GET https://ship.embarko.ai/capabilities` is generated by the platform.

## Contents

| Section | Topic | One line |
|---|---|---|
| Start | [prerequisites](prerequisites.md) | What Embarko is, how to talk to the person, which route to use, does the app fit |

| Manage | [update](update.md) | Ship a change: same name, deploy again |
| Manage | [status](status.md) | Every status and how long to wait |
| Manage | [logs](logs.md) | Why a build failed or an app crashed |

Every topic is also at `<topic>.md` (raw markdown) and `<topic>.json`. Everything in one file: `llms-full.txt`.

Hosts, all Embarko: `ship.embarko.ai` (API), `embarko.ai` (dashboard), `<app-name>.embarko.app` (apps), `github.com` (the optional skill).
